notes.title: Ledger architecture
notes.text: Requests flow inward through the layers; nothing in a lower layer imports an upper one.

notes.title: Postgres store
notes.provides: All SQL for entries, periods, tenants and reporting views; the only module that opens a database connection.

notes.title: ADR 0003: Event bus for audit and email
notes.path: ADR 0003: Event bus for audit and email
notes.text: Audit records and outbound email are produced by subscribers on the in-process Event bus.
